# pve_node_storages (Data Source)

Storage pools available on a node; optionally one pool's detail and status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_node_storages" "example" {
  node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `content` (String) Only list stores which support this content type.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Only list stores which are enabled (not disabled in config). (default: 0)
- `format` (Boolean) Include information about formats (default: 0)
- `storage` (String) Only list status for  specified storage
- `target` (String) If target is different to 'node', we only lists shared storages which content is accessible on this 'node' and the specified 'target' node.

### Read-Only

- `detail` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detail))
- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>/<storage>.
- `status` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))
- `storages` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/storage. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storages))
